categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in two segments: power supply units and electric vehicle (EV) energy solutions, including EV charging stations. It also engages in manufacturing and sales of electronic components and energy-related products, with a focus on power adapters, chargers, and EV charging infrastructure.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: Core technologies include switched-mode power supply (SMPS) design, wide bandgap semiconductors such as GaN and SiC for high efficiency and miniaturization, advanced power electronics, and digital control integration. Production methods emphasize automation, computer simulation, and smart manufacturing to enhance quality and efficiency. The company also develops bi-directional charging technologies (V2H, V2G) and high-power charging systems up to 720kW and megawatt levels for heavy vehicles.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are in the consumer electronics, telecommunications, computing, industrial automation, and electric vehicle sectors. The company serves global markets including North America, Europe, and Asia, supplying major international brands and infrastructure operators. End markets include smartphones, laptops, electric bikes, electric cars, buses, and industrial equipment.
categories.geographic_coverage: Operations and sales cover Taiwan, China (Dongguan, Suzhou, Jiangxi), Vietnam (Haiphong), Japan, the United States, Singapore, and Europe (Netherlands). The company has manufacturing and R&D facilities in these regions and targets global markets with a strong presence in North America, Europe, and Asia.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain, focusing on product design, manufacturing, and sales of power supplies and EV charging equipment. It maintains upstream relationships with component suppliers but does not engage in raw material extraction or semiconductor fabrication.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include expanding EV charging infrastructure globally, enhancing R&D in high-efficiency power supplies using GaN and SiC technologies, developing bi-directional charging and smart grid integration, and pursuing sustainability through ESG initiatives. The company invests heavily in digital power platforms, cybersecurity for EV charging, and high-power charging solutions, while optimizing cost and supply chain localization.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through product sales of power supplies and EV charging equipment. The company also derives income from related services such as energy solutions and infrastructure consulting. Sales are predominantly B2B, with a focus on long-term contracts and partnerships with OEMs and infrastructure operators.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Major competitors include global power supply manufacturers like Delta Electronics, Lite-On Technology, and international EV charging providers such as ChargePoint, Tesla Supercharger, and Siemens. The company positions itself as a technology leader in power supply efficiency and EV charging innovation, leveraging strong R&D and global manufacturing footprint to compete in niche and high-growth markets.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company reported consolidated revenues of approximately NT$10.9 billion in the latest fiscal year, with a slight decline from the previous year due to market challenges. Net profit was around NT$206 million, reflecting a modest decrease. The firm maintains a solid asset base with ongoing investments in capacity expansion and R&D, aiming for sustainable growth amid global economic uncertainties.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes superior design, high product quality, and reliable delivery schedules. Its differentiation lies in advanced power electronics technologies, including GaN-based power supplies and high-power EV charging solutions with smart dynamic load management. Commitment to ESG and sustainability, along with comprehensive global service and localized supply chains, further enhance its competitive advantage.
